chunks: The day He will gather all of them together, He will ask the angels: 'Did they worship you?'
ai.seo_question: What does Allah ask the angels on the Day of Judgment regarding idol worship?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Saba, Allah addresses the angels to clarify that the idols worshipped by humans were merely created entities, not divine beings, thereby refuting the polytheists' claim of serving intermediaries. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Tabarsi, emphasize that this rhetorical question serves to expose the absurdity of idolatry by distinguishing between the worshippers' intent and the actual status of the idols. This moment underscores the ultimate accountability of humans for their choice of worship, whether directed toward Allah or false deities.
